constraints.name: BOARD_RANGE
constraints.derivation: manufacturing caliper range for folding-carton board; every compensation in the contract derives from t

constraints.name: HEIGHT_GT_WIDTH
constraints.derivation: tuck-carton proportion: the tuck closure needs the body taller than the opening span

constraints.name: GLUE_CLEARANCE
constraints.derivation: the glue flap laps inside the side span; less than 3 mm of clearance overlaps the side fold (adapted-source guard)

constraints.name: DUST_BASE_MIN
constraints.derivation: dust-flap base after the 3 mm chamfer and 2 mm taper must keep a 2 mm manufacturable base (minimum feature)

constraints.name: FOLD_HINGE_MIN
constraints.derivation: the tuck-fold crease is shortened by a 7 mm entry slit at each end; below a 10 mm remaining span the fold has no functional hinge

constraints.name: TUCK_TIP_MIN
constraints.derivation: the flat tuck tip between the Bezier shoulders must keep a 4 mm span or the shoulders cross (self-intersection)

constraints.name: DUST_PAIR_CLEARANCE
constraints.derivation: FOLDED: opposing dust flaps (depth (P + hook - t)/2 each) meet across the inner width; W - 2*dust_d >= 2 mm or they collide (measured on the actual outlines by the folded checks)

constraints.name: EAR_ENGAGEMENT
constraints.derivation: the entry slit must cross the fold beyond the 2t locking ear by >= 0.5 mm or the ear cannot snap in

constraints.name: HOOK_VS_BODY
constraints.derivation: FOLDED: the tuck hook folds down inside the opposite main face and must clear the body height
